title: Machine scenario (parameters/machine/scenarios.yaml)
description: A named, versioned LHμC (or related-machine) configuration. It does not hold numbers itself: every slot references a parameter_id in parameters/**, so the single source of truth is the parameter record.

design_version.description: Which published design iteration this represents (e.g. DIS2026 proceedings Table 1, PTEP 2026 post-erratum).

parameters.description: role -> parameter_id. Roles are free-form but should use the canonical names listed in docs/architecture.md (muon_beam_energy, proton_beam_energy, sqrt_s, peak_luminosity, collision_rate, repetition_rate, muon_bunch_population, proton_bunch_population, muon_bunches, sigma_x_ip, sigma_y_ip, beta_x_star_muon, beta_y_star_muon, ...).

unknown_roles.description: Roles for which no value is available in this scenario.
